description_ru: Юмористический рассказ о том, как человек, который умеет сжигать даже воду, решил испечь торт маме на день рождения.
text:
Last month, my mother had a birthday, and I decided to make her a cake. This was a bad idea from the beginning, because I am the kind of person who can burn water. But my mother always buys me a present, and I felt that it was time to do something nice for her. I found a recipe on the internet. It was called "Easy Chocolate Cake for Beginners". I should have been suspicious of the word "easy".

On Saturday morning, I went to the supermarket with a list. I bought eggs, flour, sugar, butter and chocolate. I also bought a very expensive box of little silver balls to decorate the top. At home, I put everything on the kitchen table and looked at the recipe. It said, "Mix the dry ingredients." I did not know which ingredients were dry. I decided that sugar was dry, flour was dry and the chocolate was maybe a bit damp. I put everything into a big bowl.

The first problem was the eggs. The recipe said, "Break three eggs into a cup." I broke the first one, and half of the shell fell into the cup. I tried to take it out with a spoon, but the shell kept running away from me. After five minutes, I used my fingers, and the egg ran down my sleeve. The second egg dropped on the floor, and my cat, Mr Whiskers, came to look at it. He is not a clever cat, but even he seemed disappointed. The third egg was perfect. I was so proud that I took a photograph.

Then I turned on the oven. The recipe said 180 degrees, but I thought that a hot oven makes a faster cake. So I chose 250. While the oven was getting hot, I stirred the mixture with a wooden spoon. It was much thicker than the picture on the internet. It looked like cement. I added some milk. Then it looked like soup, so I added more flour. After a while, I had enough mixture for twelve cakes, and I had to use two bowls.

I poured the mixture into a tin and put it in the oven. Then I went to the sitting room to watch television, because I was tired. "Bake for thirty minutes," the recipe said, and I thought that I would only close my eyes for a moment. When I woke up, there was a strange smell in the flat. It smelled like a campfire. I ran into the kitchen, and the room was full of grey smoke. The cake was black, and it was smaller than a football. The smoke alarm was screaming, and Mr Whiskers was sitting on top of the fridge, looking at me as if I had done something terrible.

I opened all the windows and waved a towel in the air. Five minutes later, my neighbour, Mrs Klein, rang the bell. She was holding a fire extinguisher, and she looked very worried. "Is everything all right?" she asked. "I thought your kitchen was on fire." I explained that I was just baking a cake. She looked at the black thing on the table and said, "Is that a cake, or is it a piece of coal?" I said that it was an experimental cake. She was very polite and did not laugh for at least three seconds.

I had only two hours before the party, so I had to find a plan. First, I tried to cut the burnt part away, but there was nothing left that was not burnt. Then I wanted to cover it with chocolate. I melted the rest of the chocolate in a pan, but I forgot to turn off the heat, and it became hard and bitter. In the end, I decided to go back to the supermarket. I bought a big, beautiful cake with strawberries on top. It was twice as expensive as I expected, but it was better than my cake in every possible way.

At home, I put the strawberry cake on a plate, and I threw the burnt one into the bin. I also decided to hide the evidence. I cleaned the kitchen and opened the windows again, but my flat still smelled like a factory. When my mother arrived, she took one breath and said, "Did you cook something?" I said, "No, of course not. It is a new perfume."

The party was lovely. Everybody ate the cake and said it was delicious. My mother said that it was the best cake she had ever tasted. I smiled and said nothing. Then Mrs Klein arrived with a small gift, and she looked at the cake. "This is much better than the coal," she whispered to me. I almost choked on my tea.

Since then, I have learned two important lessons. First, I will never trust a recipe with the word "easy". Second, if you want to give someone a cake, buy one. It is cheaper than the cost of a new smoke alarm, and much better for your cat's opinion of you.

questions.question: What did the writer want to make?
questions.answer: A chocolate cake for his mother's birthday.

questions.question: What was wrong with the oven?
questions.answer: The writer set it to 250 degrees instead of 180.

questions.question: What happened while he watched television?
questions.answer: He fell asleep, and the cake burned and made a lot of smoke.

questions.question: What did the writer do in the end?
questions.answer: He bought a cake with strawberries from the supermarket.
